title: 第21章 我五指峰要出人才了第22章 青云宗十八最
slug: 什么梦中的娘子都是真的
content_zh:
万魂诀是万魂殿的立宗之本。
也是无上魔功。
操纵万魂为所用。
吞天蔽日，威力无穷！
但也有弊端。
要想万魂强大，就必须找那些怨念极重的魂魄炼制。
久而久之。
当万魂怨念积攒到一种恐怖的地步时。
就很容易影响施法者的心智。
从而让其走火入魔，陷入疯狂。
五长老宋无仁的话。
提醒了姚长宁。
祝蝶真无缘无故，不由分说的击杀大长老尚不易。
此事，真的很像两百年前的祝玄英。
大长老都能杀。
更何况他二长老姚长宁了。
在这个时候。
姚长宁心中一寒。
决不能让祝玄英的事件再度发生。
否则，谁敢保证，下一个死的人，不会是自己？

姚长宁神色凝重。
“五长老的意思是，我们应该提前做好自保措施？”
“那是自然，没有人愿意慷慨赴死。
但若有人非想要我死。
那么我自然会做出反击！”
宋无仁露出一抹阴柔的笑意。
姚长宁眼中也闪过决绝之色。
没错。
没有谁愿意去死。
若有谁想要逼死他。
那么他肯定会想办法弄死那个人。
哪怕，是殿主祝蝶真也在所不惜！
......
第二天一大早。
谢沐灵便催促建造堂的弟子来五指峰，建造新的竹屋。
而且选址特意选在了自己竹屋旁边。
“记住，所有的竹子材料，必须要上品灵竹。
打磨必须干净。
家具设计必须合理。
最重要的是，速度要快，今天就要做好。”

听着这一连串的要求。
建造堂三师兄公输哲顿时面露难色。
content_en:
The Ten Thousand Souls Jue is the foundation of the Ten Thousand Souls Palace.
It is also a supreme magic power.
Manipulate all souls for your own use.
Swallowing the sky and blocking out the sun, its power is endless!
But there are also disadvantages.
If you want Ten Thousand Souls to be powerful, you must find those souls with great resentment to refine them.
Over time.
When the resentment of thousands of souls accumulates to a terrifying level.
It is easy to affect the mind of the caster.
This caused him to become obsessed and fall into madness.
The words of Fifth Elder Song Wuren.
Yao Changning was reminded.
It is not easy for Zhu Die to kill the great elder without any reason.
This matter is really similar to Zhu Xuanying two hundred years ago.
Even the great elder can kill him.
Not to mention his second elder Yao Changning.
at this time.
Yao Changning felt a chill in his heart.
The incident involving Zhu Xuanying must not be allowed to happen again.
Otherwise, who can guarantee that the next person to die will not be him?
Yao Changning looked solemn.
"What the fifth elder means is that we should take self-protection measures in advance?"
"That's natural, no one wants to die generously.
But if someone really wants me to die.
Then I will naturally fight back! "
Song Wuren showed a soft smile.
Yao Changning's eyes also flashed with determination.
That's right.
No one wants to die.
If anyone wants to force him to death.
Then he will definitely find a way to kill that person.
Even if it is the palace master Zhu Diezhen, he will not hesitate!
...
Early the next morning.
Xie Muling then urged the disciples from the construction hall to come to Wuzhi Peak to build a new bamboo house.
And the location was specially chosen next to my own bamboo house.
“Remember, all bamboo materials must be high-grade spiritual bamboo.
The sanding must be clean.
Furniture design must be reasonable.
Most importantly, be quick and get it done today. "
Listen to this series of requests.
Gong Shuzhe, the third senior brother of the Construction Hall, suddenly looked embarrassed.
